notes: The first branch stops at «عن شعبة»; the second, «حدثني بشر بن خالد», is a separate isnad for the same saying and writes its own names, so no tail is shared.
«سمعت أبا وائل، يحدث عن حذيفة» : سليمان heard Abu Wa'il, so أبا وائل is a link (rule 5); Hudhayfa is the last narrator.
Umar's question and his words are inside the saying, so Umar is not a link; «وأمرنا مسروقا» is a scene remark.
